name: Tuna & Potato Salad
method: Cook the chopped potatoes in gently boiling water for 20 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, mix the lemon juice, crushed garlic and mixed herbs in a salad bowl and stir in the chopped onion.
Drain the potatoes and add them to the bowl while still hot so they soak up the dressing, then leave to cool.
Add the drained tuna, halved tomatoes and chopped cucumber, stir gently, season with black pepper and serve, or cover and chill.
